messages.subject: Global Mining & Natural Resources Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Theoklitou-Panagiotou,

I am reaching out for consideration for senior international leadership mandates across mining and natural resources.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, executive communications and country-facing stakeholder leadership within a major gold-mining operation.

My strongest fit is in Director, VP, Country and Regional appointments where responsible development, institutional credibility, social licence and operating execution must work together. I work across ministries, regulators, communities, executive leadership and technical functions, translating external requirements into accountable business action.

Your leadership of CSG Talent's Mining and Natural Resources division, including senior and expatriate networks across global markets, makes this a focused introduction. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate and rotational leadership roles across the GCC, Africa, Asia-Pacific, Europe and the Americas.

My executive CV is attached for review. I would value consideration for mandates spanning ESG and Sustainability, Government Relations, External and Corporate Affairs, Stakeholder Relations, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership across mining and natural resources.

Best regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
